## Who I am
Muhammad Asaad Areeb is an AI systems engineer and data scientist specialising in:
- LLM fine-tuning (LoRA, full fine-tuning, Llama 2, RoBERTa)
- RAG pipeline architecture (LlamaIndex, Pinecone, Chroma, MiniLM, embeddings)
- Agentic AI workflows (tool-calling, orchestration, FastAPI)
- Power BI and enterprise BI (DAX, star schema, ERP/CRM integration, SQL Server)
- Computer vision and edge AI (YOLOv5, DeepLab v3, ONNX, TFLite)
- Applied ML research (Graduate Fellow, SPIDER Lab, Information Technology University)

## Education
